cohort: The study included 234 women of childbearing age undergoing myomectomy for uterine fibroids, excluding those who were postmenopausal, had primary ovarian insufficiency, tubal factor infertility, or suspected malignant uterine masses.
finding: Laparoscopic myomectomy (LM) is a safe and appropriate alternative to abdominal myomectomy (AM) for women of childbearing age, associated with longer operative times but shorter hospital stays and a higher subsequent pregnancy rate.
mod_finding: The vaginal delivery rate after LM was approximately 70%, and vaginal delivery after LM is generally safe with no reported uterine rupture.
